cases.name: malformed-json
cases.reason: Request body is not valid JSON.

cases.name: missing-fields
cases.reason: Request must contain "paymentPayload" and "paymentRequirements" objects. Problems at: paymentPayload, paymentRequirements.

cases.name: search-without-query
cases.reason: The `query` parameter is required and must be a non-empty search string.

cases.name: unknown-endpoint
cases.reason: No such endpoint: GET /discovery/resource. This facilitator serves /verify, /settle, /supported, /discovery/resources, /discovery/search, /health and /metrics.

cases.name: unknown-x402-version
cases.reason: This facilitator implements x402 version 2 only. No facilitator registered for x402 version: 99.

cases.name: unserved-network
cases.reason: Network eip155:8453 is not served by this facilitator. Supported: stellar:testnet.

cases.name: unsupported-scheme
cases.reason: Scheme handshake is not supported on stellar:testnet. This facilitator implements the "exact" scheme.

cases.name: tampered-amount
cases.reason: The transfer amount does not exactly match the amount in the payment requirements.

cases.name: wrong-recipient
cases.reason: The transfer recipient does not match the payTo address in the payment requirements.

cases.name: wrong-asset
cases.reason: The contract invoked by the transaction is not the asset named in the payment requirements.

cases.name: malformed-transaction
cases.reason: The payload transaction is missing or is not a base64-encoded Stellar transaction.

cases.name: stripped-auth-entries
cases.reason: The transaction contains no Soroban authorization entries.

cases.name: auth-entry-signature-cleared
cases.reason: Simulating the payment transaction against current ledger state failed.

cases.name: recipient-trustline-removed
cases.reason: The payTo account has no trustline to the payment asset and cannot receive it.

cases.name: payer-balance-drained
cases.reason: The payer's balance of the payment asset is lower than the required amount.

cases.name: replayed-payload
cases.reason: This authorization has already been used. Soroban consumed its nonce, so it cannot be settled again.

cases.name: catalog-resource-url-missing
cases.reason: The payment payload carries a bazaar extension but no resource.url to catalog it under.

cases.name: catalog-non-http-url
cases.reason: Resource URL must be http(s); got "ftp:".

cases.name: catalog-ownership-conflict
cases.reason: This resource is already cataloged under payTo GCCPYJZ23TOU7WH2FFJZNUKKGMIBCCTQVJL573RHBHAEWEXUWM6FGFJS; a payment to GDW4AVP3XYW5FGWRZCEOF6R5L5NZUHRX6EUFSDXZHDBS6T6KM77T2TBM cannot modify it. If you control this domain, list GDW4AVP3XYW5FGWRZCEOF6R5L5NZUHRX6EUFSDXZHDBS6T6KM77T2TBM in the ACCOUNTS array of its SEP-1 stellar.toml and pay again — a domain-verified seller takes precedence over an unverified one.
